title: Cosmic Serpent and Stag
description: A large iridescent purple and green snake with red eyes holds a thin arrow in its mouth, positioned centrally against a swirling cosmic vortex. A translucent green stag with antlers and a faint female profile face emerge from the swirling patterns of purple, green and starry space filled with concentric spiral motifs.
prompt: A majestic iridescent purple and green snake with piercing red eyes holds a wooden arrow in its mouth, emerging from a swirling cosmic nebula of purple and green with starry particles. A translucent glowing green stag with large antlers appears on the left beside a faint silhouette of a woman's profile, all interwoven with hypnotic concentric spiral patterns in a dreamlike surreal composition.
